x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Generates a REST HTTP API client from an OpenAPI description file.

options.name: --openapi
options.description: The path or URI to the OpenAPI description file used to generate the code files.

options.name: --output
options.description: The output directory path for the generated code files. [default: ./output]

options.name: --internal-type-access-modifiers
options.description: Makes every generated type internal instead of public.

options.name: --namespace-name
options.description: The root namespace to use for the generated handlers and models. [default: ApiSdk]

options.name: --http-client-name
options.description: The name the generated handlers dispatch under (Consts.HttpClientName): the IHttpClientFactory client name and the key of the client's JSON options. Defaults to the description's info.title, or the namespace name when the title is missing.

options.name: --log-level
options.description: The log level to use when logging messages to the main output. [default: Warning]

options.name: --additional-data
options.description: Includes the 'AdditionalData' property for models. [default: true]

options.name: --clean-output
options.description: Removes all files from the output directory before generating the code files.

options.name: --structured-mime-types
options.description: The MIME types with optional priorities as defined in RFC9110 Accept header to use for structured data model generation. Only JSON types (application/json, text/json, */*+json) and text/plain are supported. Accepts multiple values. [default: application/json|text/plain;q=0.9]

options.name: --include-path
options.description: The paths to include in the generation. Glob patterns accepted. Accepts multiple values. Append #OPERATION to the pattern to specify the operation to include. e.g. users/*/messages#GET

options.name: --exclude-path
options.description: The paths to exclude from the generation. Glob patterns accepted. Accepts multiple values. Append #OPERATION to the pattern to specify the operation to exclude. e.g. users/*/messages#GET

options.name: --disable-validation-rules
options.description: The OpenAPI description validation rules to disable. Accepts multiple values.

options.name: --clear-cache
options.description: Clears any cached data for the current command.
